title: MeetMyPets — App Launch Film

timing_basis.note: Downbeat n = 2.510 + n x bar. Every bar has a ~0.33 s bass gap before the next downbeat; transitions live in that gap.

fonts.wordmark: Love Ya Like A Sister (chosen by the user for the MeetMyPets wordmark)

characters.Shiro: the user's pet: Shiro, a young adult cream Shiba Inu: pale cream-white coat with faint warm-biscuit shading on the ears and back, cream urajiro cheeks, small upright triangular ears, dark almond-shaped eyes, black nose and lips, tightly curled tail over the back, wearing a slim glossy red leather collar (#E8102E) with a small round brushed-gold tag
characters.Tom: the matched pet: Tom, a young adult golden retriever: medium-gold wavy coat with lighter feathering on ears, chest and legs, friendly dark-brown eyes, black nose, wearing a forest-green flat fabric collar (no tag text)

visual_language.two_loops: The story line of the film. Shiro's loop-line (coral #FF1744 -> #FF7A00) and Tom's loop-line (amber #FFC107 -> #FF7A00) are thin glossy 3D tubes with the same stroke weight as the logo. They draw themselves through the scenes and do the transitions instead of generic ribbons or whips. Shiro's is born in S01, Tom's in S09. They first cross at the Follow (S12), touch at the like (S14), interlock into the match symbol on the drop (S15), braid the features together (S20) and pull tight into the woven logo (S21). The logo is literally the two pets' paths.
visual_language.paw_tap: Every tap is a soft paw-pad glyph (from the app's Paw.svg) that presses with a little squash and a thin ripple ring. It is coral for Shiro's owner. It replaces cursor hands and plain dots.
visual_language.tag_type: Headlines arrive one to three words per beat in Bricolage Grotesque. The key word lands inside a rounded pill shaped like a pet's collar tag (the same radius as the app's info chips), hanging from a tiny ring. It swings and settles (damped pendulum, ~0.5 s). Other words spring in with a short blur.
visual_language.swipe_cuts: Act changes use the app's own gestures: the whole frame becomes a card and is swiped by a paw. Swiping right flashes the app's heart stamp for 2 frames. A Feed change is swiped up like a scroll. Used only 3 times (S02->S03, S10->S11, S19->S20).
visual_language.ring_to_loop: The app's real completion capsule closes at 100% and stretches into Shiro's loop. Product UI becomes the brand motif.
visual_language.interactive_widgets: Every feature is shown by using it: the widget lifts out of the phone as a 3D layer cut pixel-exact from the Figma export, flies to the camera, gets a paw-tap and responds exactly as in the app (typing, toggles, chips, likes, counters, flips). Each shot has its own camera idea (overhead, worm's-eye, over-the-shoulder, billboard dolly, orbit), never the same phone move twice.
visual_language.wide_layout: 16:9 for YouTube. Copy sits in the free side of the frame; the side changes with each act.

transition_rule: Every transition happens inside the outgoing shot's last 0.33 s (its transition_window). Incoming shots start exactly on the downbeat, so overlaps never add time.

shots.title: Settle in.
shots.purpose: The story starts like every user's: open the app and sign in.
shots.composition: Phone right of centre, tilted 3/4; the Login screen comes apart into floating layers; each widget flies to the camera when it is used. Kicker + title top-left.
shots.camera: Starts with the splash filling the frame; pulls back and arcs 40 deg around the phone while the layers separate; then pushes to each widget as it comes forward.
shots.motion: 9.132 splash wipes to Login. 9.96 layers lift (staggered). 10.79 email forward + paw-tap + typing. 12.86 password forward + paw-tap + dots. 14.10 Login forward + paw-tap + press -> loading circle -> red burst.
shots.ui_interaction: Splash -> Login. The Login screen separates into layers. Email field: paw-tap, orange focus ring, the address types itself. Password field: paw-tap, dots type in. Login button: paw-tap, it presses, shrinks into a loading circle, and the circle bursts into the red of the next screen.
shots.vfx: Soft contact shadows under every lifted layer; the screen behind dims slightly; a focus glow on the active field.
shots.transition_in: The glow from S03 wakes the screen.
shots.transition_out: The Login button's loading circle bursts into a red disc that fills the frame: the red header of Complete Your Profile.
shots.sfx: Soft key ticks, one tap per paw (-20 dB).
